why: the bare ask answers what is true here: uptime, memory, disk, address, kernel, host — each a tile only when it has something to say, so two is the floor anywhere
kernel and host share one word list — asking for either answers both, kernel first on score
the host tile follows the kernel's — name on the title, nothing else it needs to say
memory is a proportion so its tile carries a progress bar — checked only where the box can read it, the way the script needs free
a battery tile exists only where a battery does — checked only when the box has one
a word none of the readings carries is silence, not an error tile
